title: Error while pairing dash
symptom: While pairing first Dash pod, after filling pod and getting 2 beeps, on the step of initializing pod, it couldn't connect. Restarting the app/process then it connected successfully the second time.
cause: The user speculated that setting the pump to Dash and starting from a clean state might have avoided the issue, but no definitive cause was established.
fix: Restarting the app/process allowed successful connection on the second attempt. The user also suggested that starting from a clean state after switching to Dash might avoid the issue.
evidence_quote: Restarting the app/process then it connected successfully the second time.
